name: devhub
description: Author a repo's dev-hub features: write or fix its committed devhub.toml so the repo's tooling shows up as buttons in dev-hub — in that repo's drawer or on the hub's Project tab — and write the plugin behind it when the options have to be computed at the moment someone looks. Also catalogues a repo into a followed catalogue.toml so devhub clones it and shows those features at all, committing and pushing to that shared repo with explicit confirmation at each step. Knows the traps that produce a manifest which parses cleanly and then refuses to run.
